fixture: Production HTTP and actual pointer drawing in Chromium; 1,134,000 synthetic retained observations; posed restore/separation fixtures; independent 16-setup bundles; immutable source hashes and exact child coordinates. Unit tests also exercise 64-bit IDs above 2^31, repeated compact recesses, wide-shape rejection, a continuing cylindrical service, wall preservation, cancellation, failed-save rollback and cache protection.
semantics: The drawn area defines an example, while matching streams the whole retained registered cloud with no million-point admission cap. Calibration and map-window resolutions are bounded independently of source count. Optional view filters are off by default. Review/removal/separation uses full-density original IDs, not preview samples. Workspace Undo reverses source masks and child creation together. Previous deleted-area restore/export, both-sided lining selection and independent registered-cloud preservation remain included.
algorithm: Independent geometric footprint and lining-offset template matching with overlapping FFT windows and angular wrapping. Continuing services follow connected candidate cells within the example depth range. This is not a trained semantic classifier; geometric scores are not probabilities. Unsupported lining remains unselected.
recovery_limit: Previously permanently removed caches cannot be recreated by this update.
